question: geojson all segments passeio marítimo de algés
sql: SELECT id, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE names."primary" = 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés'

question: wkt of 5 sample sidewalk segments
sql: SELECT id, ST_AsText(geometry) AS wkt FROM lisbon_roads WHERE subclass = 'sidewalk' LIMIT 5

question: start lon lat of each tertiary segment round 6
sql: SELECT id, ROUND(ST_X(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 6) AS start_lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 6) AS start_lat FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'tertiary'

question: total footway length km 1 decimal
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000, 1) AS total_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway'

question: midpoint lat lon string per crosswalk segment
sql: SELECT id, printf('%.5f, %.5f', ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry)), ST_X(ST_Centroid(geometry))) AS lat_lon FROM lisbon_roads WHERE subclass = 'crosswalk'

question: longest secondary segment geojson + km
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson, ROUND(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry) / 1000, 2) AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'secondary' ORDER BY ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry) DESC LIMIT 1
